title: Uwell Viscore Pineapple Ice Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Pineapple Ice combines the juicy sweetness of pineapple with a crisp menthol finish, offering a tropical and refreshing vape. Designed for use with the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack features a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for extended usability and convenience. The pod is equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, delivering rich flavour and satisfying vapour. The refill container ensures quick and effortless top-ups, offering up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it a fantastic choice for adult vapers seeking a high-quality vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the bright, tropical Pineapple Ice flavour.
